rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 買収した水処理会社(統合を進めた)
relations.text_en: Water treatment company it acquired and integrated

source.label: Xylem 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The charges incurred primarily related to strengthening our competitive positioning and the integration of Evoqua Water Technologies Corp.

relations.text: 2023年4月に25.1%を出資した戦略的合弁
relations.text_en: Took a 25.1% stake in April 2023 as a strategic joint venture

source.label: Xylem 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 26, 2023, we acquired a 25.1 % equity interest in Global Omnium Idrica S.L.

companies.name: ローパー・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Roperが出資するIndicorが、ポンプ事業(Cornell Pump・Roper Pump)を約14.6億ドルでXylemに売却する契約を締結
relations.text_en: Indicor, in which Roper holds a stake, agreed to sell its Cornell Pump and Roper Pump businesses to Xylem for about $1.46 billion

source.label: Roper Technologies 10-Q(2026年第3四半期)
source.quote: On August 10, 2026, Indicor entered into a definitive agreement to divest its flow controls businesses, Cornell Pump and Roper Pump ("Indicor Flow Controls"), to Xylem Inc.

companies.name: ミューラー・ウォーター・プロダクツ

relations.text: Muellerが10-Kで、補修市場の主な競合としてXylemを挙げる
relations.text_en: Mueller names Xylem among its primary competitors in the repair market

source.label: Mueller Water Products 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors in the repair market are Romac Industries, Xylem Inc., Viking Johnson, AVK Group, JCM Industries, and Georg Fischer Ltd.

relations.text: Itronが10-Kで、主な競合としてXylemを挙げる
relations.text_en: Itron names Xylem among its primary competitors

source.label: Itron 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include LM Ericsson Telephone Company, Landis+Gyr, Advanced Energy Industries, and Xylem, Inc.

relations.text: Badger Meterが10-Kで、競合製品を持つ企業としてXylem傘下のSensusを挙げる
relations.text_en: Badger Meter names Xylem's Sensus among companies with competing offerings

source.label: Badger Meter 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: organizations such as Sensus (Xylem Inc.), Neptune (Roper Technologies), Hach (Veralto), Itron, Aclara (Hubbel), Mueller Water, Kamstrup and others have select elements of competitive hardware

companies.name: モントローズ・エンバイロメンタル

relations.text: Montroseが10-Kで、浄化・再利用事業の競合としてXylemを挙げる
relations.text_en: Montrose names Xylem among competitors of its remediation and reuse segment

source.label: Montrose Environmental 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our Remediation and Reuse segment competitors include the environmental divisions or remediation segments of Tetra Tech, AECOM, Xylem, Veolia, Mead & Hunt

relations.text: BioLargoが10-Kで、自社の処理システムの競合メーカーとしてXylemを挙げる
relations.text_en: BioLargo names Xylem among makers of systems its AEC technology competes with

source.label: BioLargo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our AEC system competes against granular activated carbon, ion-exchange and reverse osmosis systems made by companies such as Veolia, AECOM, Xylem and Pentair.

companies.name: フランクリン・エレクトリック

relations.text: Franklin Electricの契約書で、「直接の競合」の一社としてXylemを定義
relations.text_en: A Franklin Electric agreement defines Xylem as one of its direct competitors

source.label: Franklin Electric 10-Q添付契約(2025年第1四半期)
source.quote: "Direct Competitor" is defined as, and expressly limited to any of the following, including their affiliates and assigns: Lorentz, Pentair, Grundfos, Xylem

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
